editorial:
Imagine working in a quiet autopsy room and finding a body with no name, only to realize that cutting into it lets something evil out. That is exactly what happens to Isabella, a doctor who thinks she has everything under control until her world turns upside down. The vibe is creepy and tense from the start, making you feel the dread as the ghost starts to take over her life. It is a wild ride that mixes medical drama with scary spirits, keeping you on edge about what will happen to Isabella and the people around her.

The acting is solid and the scares land well, though some parts of the story move a bit slow in the middle. If you love jumpscares and dark secrets, you will really enjoy this one. It is best viewed in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this scary story forever.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the spirit was trying to find a new home to survive. Isabella fights a hard battle to get her soul back and stop the demon from taking over completely. After a scary showdown, the evil spirit is finally pushed out and defeated. Isabella survives the ordeal, but she is left changed forever, knowing that some things in the afterlife should never be disturbed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories and medical thrillers.
